NP Presspad 1.2.3 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Dependency updates

- **Electron** 43.2.0 → 43.3.0 (patch/minor within the current major)
- **lucide-react** (icons) 1.28.0 → 1.30.0
- **marked** (Markdown parser) 18.0.7 → 18.0.9

## Housekeeping

- Removed the unused `@types/better-sqlite3` dev dependency (the runtime ships its own types).
- Documented the `electron-builder` version pin and the `@vitejs/plugin-react` / Vite 8 hold-back rationale in `RELEASE.md` so they aren't re-derived each week.
